notes: Primary problem: legacy research portal has poor retrieval quality and high TCO for nightly full-text reranks.
Scale: ~120M documents (mix of research reports, filings, transcripts) -> expect ~300M passages after chunking.
Search architecture preference: two-stage RAG -> dense ANN for recall (HNSW/FAISS) + cross-encoder or lightweight cross-attention reranker for top-K re-score.
Latency target: p50 end-to-end search <= 150-250ms for analyst queries; p95 target softer (<= 1s) during market open bursts.
Cost target: target blended cost per query <= $0.005, ideally ~ $0.002-0.003. Big sensitivity to reranker cost — want ways to throttle re-rank or use cheaper distillation models.
Data residency: EU-only (Ireland primary), legal require data-at-rest keys in customer KMS (Azure Key Vault), HSM optional.
Security: enterprise SSO (SAML), audit logging for query-level access, retention controls (90 days default), legal hold capability requested.
Preference: Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput during market open (8:30-10:30 and 14:30-15:30 CET).
POC scope: 10M doc subset, baseline: current Lucene-based retrieval vs Redwood embeddings + reranker. Measure recall@10, MRR, avg latency, cost per query.
SE notes (Diego): consider prefix KV caching for repeating queries (trading tickers), batch small queries to reduce token cost, experiment with quantized model variants.
Quote from Head of Research: 'We need answers as fast as analysts expect — can't trade 5x cost for marginal accuracy improvements.'
Open question: whether to colocate index in client's VPC or provision Dedicated in Redwood EU region behind customer-controlled KMS; legal prefers customer KMS and private control plane.
Related wrinkles: some content must be air-gapped for a small subset of clients -> potential hybrid private/on-prem deployment later.
